title: 8086/8088 Chapter 2 MCQ Question Bank
notes: Questions marked source_status='lecture' are based on the uploaded PPT.
Segment-override questions are supplementary because the PPT does not explicitly teach segment-override syntax.
This question bank covers major concepts from the PPT; it cannot guarantee every possible exam question.

questions.question: When was the Intel 8086 introduced?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 8086 በመጋቢት 1978 ተዋወቀ። ይህን አስታውስ፤ የታሪክ ጥያቄ ነው እንጂ የhex ውጊያ አይደለም!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: March 1978. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Why is the 8086 called a 16-bit processor?

options.B: Its ALU, registers, and most instructions work with 16-bit words

questions.explanation_am: ጎበዝ! 16-bit ማለት ALUው፣ ውስጣዊ ሬጂስተሮቹና አብዛኞቹ መመሪያዎቹ 16-bit ቃላትን ለመስራት ተዘጋጅተዋል ማለት ነው። ፒን ቆጥረህ አትወስን!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Its ALU, registers, and most instructions work with 16-bit words. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: How wide is the 8086 address bus?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 8086 20-bit address bus አለው። 16-bit የdata/register ስፋትን ከ20-bit address bus ጋር አትደባልቅ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 20 bits. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the maximum memory capacity of the 8086?
questions.explanation_am: ጀግና! 2²⁰ = 1,048,576 byte አድራሻዎች ናቸው፤ ይህም በስላይዱ 1 MB ተብሏል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 1 MB. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the 8086 external data-bus width?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 8086 16-bit external data bus አለው፤ 20-bit ግን address bus ነው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 16 bits. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the 8088 external data-bus width?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 8088 8-bit external data bus አለው። ውስጣዊ አርክቴክቸሩ 16-bit ቢሆንም የውጭ ዳታ መንገዱ 8-bit ነው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 8 bits. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: How many instruction bytes can the 8086 queue hold?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 8086 6-byte queue አለው፤ 8088 ደግሞ 4-byte ነው። ቁጥሩን አትቀያይር!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 6. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which mode supports multiprocessor or coprocessor configurations?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! በስላይዱ መሠረት Maximum mode ለmultiprocessor/coprocessor ውቅር ይጠቅማል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Maximum mode. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the unsigned range of an 8-bit byte?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 8-bit unsigned ከ0 እስከ 255 ነው። አሉታዊ ቁጥሮች በsigned ክልል ውስጥ ይመጣሉ።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 0 to 255. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the signed range of an 8-bit integer?
questions.explanation_am: ጎበዝ! 8-bit signed ክልል −128 እስከ +127 ነው። ይህን ከunsigned ክልል ጋር አትደባልቅ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: −128 to +127. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the unsigned range of a 16-bit word?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 16-bit unsigned ከ0 እስከ 65,535 ይሄዳል። 2¹⁶ እሴቶች አሉ፤ ዜሮንም ቆጥር!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 0 to 65535. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the signed range of a 16-bit word?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 16-bit signed ከ−32,768 እስከ +32,767 ነው። ዜሮም አንድ እሴት እንደሚይዝ አስታውስ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: −32768 to +32767. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: How are negative signed numbers represented in the lecture?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! በስላይዱ መሠረት አሉታዊ signed ቁጥሮች two’s complement ይጠቀማሉ።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Two's complement. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: How many decimal digits fit in one packed BCD byte?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! Packed BCD አንድ byte ውስጥ ሁለት የዲሲማል አሃዞችን ይይዛል፤ እያንዳንዱ 4 bit ይወስዳል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Two. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: How much space does one unpacked BCD digit use?
questions.explanation_am: አዎ! Unpacked BCD አንድ አሃዝን በአንድ byte ያስቀምጣል፤ የላይኛው 4 bit በስላይዱ አይጠቀሙም ተብሏል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: One byte. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the valid BCD code range for one decimal digit?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! BCD አንድ አሃዝ 0–9 ነው፤ 0000₂ እስከ 1001₂። 1010₂ ከመጣ የዲሲማል አሃዝ አይደለም!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 0000₂–1001₂. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: How many code combinations can 7-bit ASCII represent?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 2⁷ = 128 የተለያዩ ኮዶች ናቸው። 7 bit ማለት 7 ቁምፊ ብቻ ማለት አይደለም!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 128. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: According to the slide, what is the byte representation of ASCII 'A'?
questions.explanation_am: ጀግና! ስላይዱ 'A'ን በ7-bit 1000001 እና በbyte 01000001 እንደሚቀመጥ ያሳያል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 01000001. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which two major units form the 8086 architecture?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 8086 በBIU (Bus Interface Unit) እና EU (Execution Unit) ይከፈላል። አንዱ ከውጭ ይገናኛል፣ ሌላው ያስኬዳል!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: BIU and EU. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which unit handles external bus operations and instruction fetching?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! BIU አድራሻ ያዘጋጃል፣ መመሪያ ያመጣል፣ ከmemory/port ያነባል እና ይጽፋል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: BIU. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which unit decodes and executes instructions?
questions.explanation_am: ጎበዝ! EU መመሪያዎችን ይፈታል እና ያስኬዳል፤ BIU ደግሞ ያመጣቸዋል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: EU. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is pipelining in the 8086?

options.B: Fetching the next instruction while the current one executes

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! BIU ቀጣዩን መመሪያ ሲያመጣ EU ያለውን ሲያስኬድ ሁለቱ ስራዎች ይደራረባሉ። የስራ ክፍፍል ነው!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Fetching the next instruction while the current one executes. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What principle does the instruction queue use?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! FIFO = First In, First Out። ወረፋ ላይ መጀመሪያ የገባው መጀመሪያ ይወጣል!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: FIFO. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which register holds the offset of the next instruction in the current code segment?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! IP በCS ውስጥ የሚገኘውን ቀጣይ መመሪያ offset ይይዛል። CS ክፍሉን፣ IP ቦታውን ያሳያል!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: IP. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the maximum size of one 8086 segment?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! አንድ segment ከፍተኛው 64 KB ነው። 1 MB የሙሉ አድራሻ ቦታ ነው፤ አትደባልቅ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 64 KB. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: How wide are CS, DS, SS, and ES?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! አራቱም segment registers 16-bit ናቸው። ከoffset ጋር ሲደመሩ 20-bit physical address ይፈጥራሉ።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 16 bits. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which segment register identifies the code segment?
questions.explanation_am: ኧረ ይህን አትርሳ! Code ከሆነ CS ነው። ስሙ ራሱ Code Segment እያለ እየጠራ ነው!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: CS. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which segment register is associated with the stack?
questions.explanation_am: Stack ከሆነ SS ነዋ! CS ካልክ ስላይዱን እንደ ዘፈን ሳታዳምጥ ነው የመጣኸው?
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: SS. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which segment register is normally used for general data?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! DS የData Segment መሠረትን ይይዛል። Data እና DS ሁለቱም D ይጀምራሉ፤ ይህን ፍንጭ ተጠቀም!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: DS. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which register is used for the extra segment and string destination convention?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ES የExtra Segment ሬጂስተር ነው፤ በstring destination ላይ DI ከES ጋር ይጣመራል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: ES. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the 8086 real-mode physical-address formula?
questions.explanation_am: የወርቅ ፎርሙላ! Physical Address = (Segment × 10H) + Offset። Segmentን አንድ hex ቦታ ወደ ግራ አንቀሳቅስ፣ offsetን ጨምር።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Segment × 10H + Offset. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: If DS=2222H, what is the segment base physical address?
questions.explanation_am: ጀግና! 2222H × 10H = 22220H። Segmentን አንድ hexadecimal ቦታ ወደ ግራ አንቀሳቅስ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 22220H. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: If CS=456AH and IP=1620H, what is the physical address?
questions.explanation_am: በደረጃ፦ 456AH × 10H = 456A0H፤ 456A0H + 1620H = 46CC0H። የhex ድምርን አትቸኩል!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 46CC0H. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Calculate the physical address for segment 1005H and offset 5555H.
questions.explanation_am: ትክክለኛው ስሌት፦ 1005H × 10H = 10050H፤ 10050H + 5555H = 155A5H። ጀግና ከሆንክ ይህን በራስህ አስላ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 155A5H. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What does a physical address represent?

options.B: The actual byte address sent on the address bus

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! Physical address በmemory ውስጥ ያለውን ትክክለኛ byte የሚያመለክት እና ወደ address bus የሚወጣ አድራሻ ነው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: The actual byte address sent on the address bus. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which pair identifies the next instruction address?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! መመሪያ አድራሻ = CS:IP። CS code segmentን፣ IP በዚያ ውስጥ ያለውን offset ይይዛል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: CS:IP. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which pair is the default stack-address combination?
questions.explanation_am: Stack ከሆነ SS:SP ወይም SS:BP ነው። SSን ከDS ጋር አትቀያይር!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: SS:SP or SS:BP. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: In register-indirect addressing, where is the memory offset held?

options.B: In a register such as BX, BP, SI, or DI

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ሬጂስተሩ የmemory አድራሻ offsetን ይይዛል፤ ውሂቡ ግን memory ውስጥ ነው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: In a register such as BX, BP, SI, or DI. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What does MOV [BX], AX do?

options.B: Stores AX in the memory location addressed by BX

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! MOV [BX], AX ማለት AX ውስጥ ያለውን ወደ BX በሚያመለክተው memory ቦታ ማስቀመጥ ነው። [] የmemory operand ፍንጭ ነው!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Stores AX in the memory location addressed by BX. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which register is commonly used to access stack data and defaults to SS?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! BP በstack ያለ ዳታን ለመድረስ ይጠቅማል እና በመደበኛነት SS ይጠቀማል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: BP. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: In string operations, which pair is normally used for the source?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! SI ከDS ጋር ለsource ይሰራል። SI = Source Index፤ ስሙን አስታውስ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: DS:SI. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: In string operations, which pair is normally used for the destination?
questions.explanation_am: ጎበዝ! DI ከES ጋር ለdestination ይሰራል። DS:SI ምንጭ፣ ES:DI መድረሻ ብለህ አስታውስ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: ES:DI. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What does a segment-override prefix do?

options.A: Changes the default segment used for a memory operand
options.D: Replaces the opcode with an offset

questions.explanation_am: ተጨማሪ እውቀት፦ ይህ ጽንሰ-ሀሳብ በPPT በግልጽ አልተብራራም። Segment override ለmemory operand የሚጠቀመውን default segment register ይቀይራል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Changes the default segment used for a memory operand. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which instruction explicitly selects ES for the memory operand at BX?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ES:[BX] በግልጽ ESን ይመርጣል። ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ የsegment-override ተጨማሪ ምሳሌ ነው፣ በስላይዱ በቀጥታ አልተብራራም።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: MOV AX, ES:[BX]. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which four are the general-purpose data registers?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! AX, BX, CX, DX አራቱ general-purpose registers ናቸው። Segment registersን ከእነዚህ ጋር አትደባልቅ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: AX, BX, CX, DX. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: If AX=1234H, what are AH and AL?
questions.explanation_am: ጀግና! AH ከፍተኛው byte 12H ነው፤ AL ዝቅተኛው byte 34H ነው። H=High፣ L=Low!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: AH=12H, AL=34H. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which register is called the accumulator?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! AX የaccumulator ሬጂስተር ነው፤ MUL እና DIV ያሉ አንዳንድ መመሪያዎች ይጠቀሙበታል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: AX. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which register is used for loop counting and many repeated instructions?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! CX የcount register ነው፤ LOOP እና REP ያሉ መመሪያዎች ይጠቀሙበታል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: CX. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which register can hold an I/O port number and works with AX in word MUL/DIV?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! DX የport ቁጥርን ሊይዝ ይችላል፣ በword-size MUL/DIV ከAX ጋርም ይሰራል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: DX. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which pair contains the pointer registers?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! SP እና BP pointer registers ናቸው። SI እና DI ግን index registers ናቸው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: SP and BP. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which pair contains the index registers?
questions.explanation_am: ጎበዝ! SI = Source Index፣ DI = Destination Index። ስማቸው ምንጭና መድረሻ ያስታውሳል!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: SI and DI. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What does SP point to?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! SP የstack ከላይኛው ንጥል offsetን ይጠቁማል። Stack LIFO ነው!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: The top of the stack. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the ALU's main job?

options.C: Hold the code segment base only

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ALU መደመር፣ መቀነስ፣ AND፣ OR፣ XOR፣ shift እና ሌሎች ስራዎችን ያከናውናል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Perform arithmetic and logical operations. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What does the instruction decoder do?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! Decoder መመሪያዎችን ይተረጉማል እና CPU ምን እንደሚያደርግ ይወስናል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Translates instructions into actions. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What is the key difference between RCL and ROL?

options.A: RCL rotates through CF; ROL does not use the old CF as input
options.B: RCL rotates right; ROL rotates right

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! RCL በCarry Flag በኩል ያዞራል፤ ROL ግን የቀድሞ CFን input አድርጎ አይጠቀምም።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: RCL rotates through CF; ROL does not use the old CF as input. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: In ROR, where does the outgoing least-significant bit go?

options.B: It wraps to the most-significant bit and is copied to CF
options.D: It moves to the sign flag only

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ROR የወጣውን የቀኝ ጫፍ bit ወደ ግራ ጫፍ ያመጣል እና CF ውስጥም ይቀዳል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: It wraps to the most-significant bit and is copied to CF. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: How wide is the 8086 flag register?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! Flag register 16-bit ነው፤ በስላይዱ መሠረት 9 individual flag bits ተጠቅሰዋል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 16 bits. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which set contains only status flags?

options.B: CF, PF, AF, ZF, SF, OF

questions.explanation_am: ጎበዝ! CF, PF, AF, ZF, SF, OF ስድስቱ status flags ናቸው። TF, IF, DF ግን control flags ናቸው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: CF, PF, AF, ZF, SF, OF. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which set contains the three control flags?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! TF, IF, DF control flags ናቸው፤ CPU ባህሪን ይቆጣጠራሉ።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: TF, IF, DF. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: When is Carry Flag set?

options.B: When unsigned arithmetic carries/borrows beyond the destination range
options.C: When a signed result is negative

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! CF በunsigned arithmetic ውስጥ carry/borrow ሲኖር ይነሳል። ከsigned overflow ጋር አትደባልቅ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: When unsigned arithmetic carries/borrows beyond the destination range. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What does Overflow Flag indicate?

options.A: Signed result does not fit the destination range

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! OF በsigned arithmetic ውጤቱ ከሚፈቀደው ክልል ሲወጣ ይነሳል። CF እና OF የተለያዩ ናቸው!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Signed result does not fit the destination range. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: When is Zero Flag set?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ZF=1 ማለት ውጤቱ ዜሮ ነው። ዜሮ ካልሆነ ZF=0!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: When the result is zero. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What does the Parity Flag reflect?

options.A: Even or odd number of 1 bits in the result

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! PF=1 ሲሆን በውጤቱ ያሉ 1 bits ብዛት እኩል ነው፤ ጎዶሎ ከሆነ PF=0።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Even or odd number of 1 bits in the result. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What does DF=1 do to string-operation direction?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! DF=1 ሲሆን string operations ይቀንሳሉ፤ DF=0 ሲሆን ይጨምራሉ። STD ያበራዋል፣ CLD ያጠፋዋል!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Automatically decrements. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which instructions clear and set IF, respectively?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! CLI የInterrupt Flagን ያጠፋል፤ STI ያበራል። STD/CLD ግን Direction Flag ላይ ይሰራሉ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: CLI and STI. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What principle does a stack follow?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! Stack LIFO ነው፤ Last In, First Out። እንደ ሳህን ክምር፣ መጨረሻ ያስቀመጥከው መጀመሪያ ይወጣል!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: LIFO. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: Which operation inserts an element into a stack?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! PUSH ያስገባል፣ POP ያወጣል። ሁለቱን ካቀላቀልክ stackህ ይበሳጫል!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: PUSH. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What happens if PUSH is attempted on a full stack?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ሙሉ stack ላይ PUSH ማድረግ overflow ያመጣል። ቦታ ከሌለ አታስገባ፤ እንደ ሚኒባስ አትጫነው!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Overflow. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: What happens if POP is attempted on an empty stack?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ባዶ stack ላይ POP ሲደረግ underflow ነው። ከባዶ ሳህን ወጥ አታውጣ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Underflow. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: In the lecture's stack example, what does TOP = −1 mean?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! TOP=−1 ማለት stack ባዶ ነው። አንድ ንጥል ሲገባ TOP=0 ይሆናል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: The stack is empty. See the question topic and lecture notes for the relevant concept.

questions.question: How many pins does the 8086 have, according to the lecture?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! በስላይዱ መሠረት 8086 40 pins አሉት። ፒኖቹን አትቆጥር ብለህ አትሸሽ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 40.

questions.question: What operating frequency is listed for the 8086 in the lecture?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! በዚህ ስላይድ 8086 የተጠቀሰው operating frequency 5 MHz ነው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 5 MHz.

questions.question: What does the MN/MX pin determine?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! MN/MX ፒን የminimum ወይም maximum mode መሆኑን ይወስናል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Minimum or maximum mode.

questions.question: According to the lecture, what happens when MN/MX is high?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! በስላይዱ መሠረት MN/MX ከፍተኛ (high) ሲሆን minimum mode ነው፤ low ሲሆን maximum mode ነው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Minimum mode.

questions.question: Which statement about the 8086 and 8088 instruction sets is correct according to the lecture?

options.A: They have completely different instruction sets
options.B: They have the same instruction set

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! በስላይዱ መሠረት 8086 እና 8088 ተመሳሳይ instruction set አላቸው። ዋናው ልዩነት የውጭ data bus ስፋት እና queue ነው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: They have the same instruction set.

questions.question: How is data stored in the 8086 memory system, according to the lecture?

options.B: In bytes, with each byte having an address
options.C: Only in segments with no byte addresses

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ዳታ በbyte ይቀመጣል፣ እያንዳንዱ byteም የራሱ አድራሻ አለው። አንድ byte እንኳ አድራሻ ይፈልጋል!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: In bytes, with each byte having an address.

questions.question: What is the lowest or starting address of a segment called?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! Segment የሚጀምርበት አድራሻ Base Address ይባላል። Offset ደግሞ ከዚያ መጀመሪያ ያለውን ርቀት ይገልጻል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Base address.

questions.question: What does an offset address measure?

options.B: The distance from the beginning of a segment to a location

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! Offset ከsegment መጀመሪያ እስከ ተፈለገው ቦታ ያለው ርቀት ነው። ከመጀመሪያው የሚቆጠር ነው!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: The distance from the beginning of a segment to a location.

questions.question: What is the range of a 16-bit segment address?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 16-bit segment address ከ0000H እስከ FFFFH ይሄዳል። 16 bit = 4 hexadecimal digits!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 0000H–FFFFH.

questions.question: What is the range of a 16-bit offset?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! Offset 16-bit ስለሆነ ከ0000H እስከ FFFFH ነው። አንድ segment እስከ 64 KB ይደርሳል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 0000H–FFFFH.

questions.question: If CS=1000H, at what physical address does the code segment begin?
questions.explanation_am: እስቲ በቀላሉ፦ 1000H × 10H = 10000H። አንድ hex ዜሮ በቀኝ ጨምር፤ ይህ የsegment መነሻ ነው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 10000H.

questions.question: How many hexadecimal digits are normally needed to write a 20-bit physical address?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! አንድ hexadecimal digit = 4 bit፤ 20 ÷ 4 = 5 digits። አምስት ቁምፊዎች ነው፣ ስድስት አይደለም!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Five.

questions.question: Calculate the physical address: 2222H:0010H.
questions.explanation_am: ደረጃው ይህ ነው፦ 2222H × 10H = 22220H፤ ከዚያ 0010H ጨምር = 22230H። የoffset ዜሮዎችን አትፍራ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 22230H.

questions.question: Calculate the physical address: 1000H:0100H.
questions.explanation_am: ትክክለኛው ስሌት፦ 1000H × 10H = 10000H፤ 10000H + 0100H = 10100H። ጀግና፣ መሠረቱን ከoffset ጋር አንድ ላይ አድርግ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 10100H.

questions.question: Calculate the physical address: 89ABH:F012H.
questions.explanation_am: በስላይዱ ያለው ምሳሌ ነው፦ 89ABH × 10H = 89AB0H፤ 89AB0H + F012H = 98AC2H። የhex መደመርን በትዕግሥት አድርግ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 98AC2H.

questions.question: If the segment base is 34BA0H and the offset is FFFFH, what is the final address?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 34BA0H + FFFFH = 44B9FH። FFFFH የ16-bit offset ከፍተኛ እሴት ነው፤ የመጨረሻ ቦታውን በትክክል ጨምር!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 44B9FH.

questions.question: Which segment:offset pair is used for ordinary data addressed through BX?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! BX በdefault ከDS ጋር ይጣመራል፤ ስለዚህ DS:BX ነው። የstack ሬጂስተር BP ሲሆን የተለየ ህግ አለው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: DS:BX.

questions.question: Which segment:offset pair is normally used for stack data addressed through BP?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! BP በdefault SS ከሚጠቀምበት የstack ክፍል ጋር ይጣመራል። BP ካየህ SSን አስታውስ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: SS:BP.

questions.question: Which segment:offset pair is normally used for source data in string operations?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! የstring source በDS:SI ይገኛል። Source = SI፣ የተለመደ segment = DS።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: DS:SI.

questions.question: Which segment:offset pair is normally used for the string destination?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! String destination = ES:DI። DI የdestination index ነው፤ ES የextra segment መሠረት ነው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: ES:DI.

questions.question: Which component in the BIU calculates the 20-bit physical address?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! BIU ውስጥ ያለው address-summing block segment baseን ከoffset ጋር ያደምራል። ይህ ነው 20-bit አድራሻውን የሚፈጥረው!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Address-summing/adder circuit.

questions.question: Which set lists components contained in the BIU according to the lecture?

options.B: IP, segment registers, 6-byte queue and address-summing block
options.C: SP, BP, SI and DI only
options.D: Decoder, control system and ALU only

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! BIU ውስጥ IP፣ CS/DS/ES/SS፣ 6-byte instruction queue እና address-summing block አሉ። EU ከBIU ጋር አትቀላቅል!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: IP, segment registers, 6-byte queue and address-summing block.

questions.question: What happens when the EU begins executing instructions already in the queue?

options.A: The BIU can fetch more instruction bytes at the same time

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! EU ያለውን ሲያስኬድ BIU ቀጣይ መመሪያዎችን ሊያመጣ ይችላል። ይህ መደራረብ pipelining ይባላል!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: The BIU can fetch more instruction bytes at the same time.

questions.question: What happens to IP as instruction fetching advances normally?

options.A: It is automatically updated to point to the next instruction offset
options.C: It stores the physical address permanently

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! IP በcode segment ውስጥ የቀጣይ መመሪያ offsetን ይይዛል እና ይዘቱ ይዘምናል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: It is automatically updated to point to the next instruction offset.

questions.question: Which unit contains the 16-bit ALU and flag register?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! EU 16-bit ALU፣ flag register፣ control system፣ decoder እና ሬጂስተሮችን ይይዛል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: EU.

questions.question: Which component manages the internal operations of the execution unit?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! Control system የEU ውስጣዊ ስራዎችን ይቆጣጠራል። Decoder መመሪያን ይፈታል፤ ALU ስሌት ይሰራል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Control system.

questions.question: Which of the following operations is performed by the ALU?

options.B: Holding the code segment base only

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ALU መደመር፣ መቀነስ፣ AND/OR/XOR፣ complement እና shifting ያከናውናል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Addition and logical AND.

questions.question: Which register can be split into AH and AL?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! AX ወደ AH (high byte) እና AL (low byte) ይከፈላል። Segment register CS ግን እንዲህ አይከፈልም!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: AX.

questions.question: If BX=ABCDH, what are BH and BL?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! BH ከፍተኛው byte ABH ነው፤ BL ዝቅተኛው CDH ነው። H=high፣ L=low ብለህ አስታውስ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: BH=ABH, BL=CDH.

questions.question: Which register is particularly associated with multiplication/division and can hold I/O port numbers?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! DX በword-size MUL/DIV ከAX ጋር ይሰራል፤ ለIN/OUT የport number ሊይዝም ይችላል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: DX.

questions.question: Which statement about BP is correct?

options.A: It only points to the next instruction
options.B: It is primarily used to access data in the stack segment and can also address other segments
options.C: It is the extra segment register
options.D: It stores only the carry flag

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! BP በተለምዶ የstack ዳታን ለመድረስ ይጠቅማል፣ ግን በተወሰኑ አድራሻ አይነቶች ሌሎች segment-ዎችንም ሊያመለክት ይችላል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: It is primarily used to access data in the stack segment and can also address other segments.

questions.question: Which registers are 16-bit offset holders used as memory pointers?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! SP፣ BP፣ SI እና DI 16-bit ናቸው፣ እንደ memory pointer/index ይጠቅማሉ።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: SP, BP, SI, DI.

questions.question: In MOV AX, [SI], what does the square-bracketed operand indicate?

options.B: The memory location whose offset is in SI
options.D: The value of the carry flag

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! [SI] ማለት SI የሚያመለክተው memory ቦታ ነው፤ SI ውስጥ ያለውን ቁጥር በቀጥታ አይደለም።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: The memory location whose offset is in SI.

questions.question: Which register combination is commonly used for based-indexed addressing in 8086?

options.A: BX or BP combined with SI or DI

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! Based-indexed addressing እንደ BX+SI፣ BX+DI፣ BP+SI ወይም BP+DI ያሉ ጥምረቶችን ሊጠቀም ይችላል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: BX or BP combined with SI or DI.

questions.question: Why might a program use a segment override?

options.A: To explicitly select a segment register other than the default for a memory operand
options.B: To increase the address bus to 32 bits
options.D: To make a 16-bit register 20 bits wide

questions.explanation_am: ተጨማሪ ጽንሰ-ሀሳብ፦ Segment override ለmemory operand ከdefault segment የተለየ ሬጂስተር በግልጽ ለመምረጥ ይጠቅማል። ይህ ክፍል በPPT በቀጥታ አልተብራራም።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: To explicitly select a segment register other than the default for a memory operand.

questions.question: In the example AL=7FH followed by ADD AL,1, what is the 8-bit result?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 7FH + 01H = 80H። በsigned ትርጉም ከፍተኛው bit 1 ስለሆነ ውጤቱ negative ይመስላል፤ ይህም OF=1 ያደርጋል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 80H.

questions.question: For AL=7FH and ADD AL,1, what are CF and OF?
questions.explanation_am: በጥንቃቄ! 7FH + 1 = 80H። ከbit 7 ውጭ carry ስለሌለ CF=0፤ ግን signed positive ወደ negative ስለተለወጠ OF=1።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: CF=0, OF=1.

questions.question: For AL=7FH and ADD AL,1, what is AF?

options.A: 0, because there is no carry from bit 3 to bit 4
options.B: 1, because there is a carry from bit 3 to bit 4

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 7FH + 1 ሲደረግ ከbit 3 ወደ bit 4 carry አለ፤ ስለዚህ AF=1። AF በተለይ ለBCD ስሌት ጠቃሚ ነው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 1, because there is a carry from bit 3 to bit 4.

questions.question: For AL=7FH and ADD AL,1, why is SF=1?

options.A: Because bit 7 of the 8-bit result 80H is 1

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 80H በ8-bit መልክ 10000000 ነው፤ bit 7 = 1 ስለሆነ SF=1።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Because bit 7 of the 8-bit result 80H is 1.

questions.question: For AL=7FH and ADD AL,1, why is ZF=0?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ውጤቱ 80H ነው፣ ዜሮ አይደለም፤ ስለዚህ ZF=0።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: The result 80H is not zero.

questions.question: For AL=7FH and ADD AL,1, why is PF=0?

options.A: The result 80H contains one 1-bit, which is odd parity
options.C: Parity is always zero after ADD

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 80H = 10000000 አንድ ብቻ የ1 bit አለው፤ ብዛቱ ጎዶሎ ስለሆነ PF=0።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: The result 80H contains one 1-bit, which is odd parity.

questions.question: What does the Auxiliary Carry Flag indicate?

options.A: Carry from bit 3 to bit 4, or the corresponding borrow
options.D: Whether the CPU is in maximum mode

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! AF ከbit 3 ወደ bit 4 የሚወጣ carry ወይም ተመሳሳይ borrow ያመለክታል። BCD ላይ ይህ አስፈላጊ ነው!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Carry from bit 3 to bit 4, or the corresponding borrow.

questions.question: What does Trap Flag (TF) control, according to the lecture?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! TF ከsingle-step/trap ባህሪ ጋር ይያያዛል፤ መመሪያዎችን በደረጃ ለመከታተል ይጠቅማል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Single-step/trap behavior after instruction execution.

questions.question: What does RCL stand for?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! RCL = Rotate through Carry Left። Bit-ዎች በCarry Flag በኩል ይዞራሉ፤ ስሙን በትክክል አስታውስ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Rotate Carry Left.

questions.question: What does RCR stand for?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! RCR = Rotate through Carry Right። የቀኝ አቅጣጫ ሲሆን Carry Flag የrotation ክፍል ነው።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Rotate Carry Right.

questions.question: What does ROL do to the leftmost bit that rotates out?

options.B: Wraps it to the rightmost bit and copies it to CF

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ROL የግራ ጫፍ bitን ወደ ቀኝ ጫፍ ያመጣል እና ወደ CF ይቀዳዋል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Wraps it to the rightmost bit and copies it to CF.

questions.question: For ROR, if AL=10010110 and the least-significant bit is 0, what is the result after one rotate right?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! የቀኝ ጫፍ bit 0 ነው፤ ወደ ግራ ጫፍ ይመለሳል። 10010110 → 01001011፣ CF=0።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 01001011.

questions.question: Which register specifies the stack segment's base?
questions.explanation_am: Stack ሲባል SS ነው! SS የstack segment baseን ይይዛል፣ SP ደግሞ በዚያ segment ውስጥ ያለውን offset ይጠቁማል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: SS.

questions.question: What is the relationship between SS and SP?

options.A: SS identifies the stack segment and SP gives the top-of-stack offset
options.B: SS is the offset and SP is the code segment
options.D: SP stores the physical address in 20 bits

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! SS የstack ክፍሉን ያሳያል፤ SP በዚያ ክፍል ውስጥ የstack top offsetን ይይዛል። Segment እና offset ሁለቱም ያስፈልጋሉ!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: SS identifies the stack segment and SP gives the top-of-stack offset.

questions.question: What is the main difference between PUSH and POP?

options.A: PUSH removes an item and POP inserts one
options.B: PUSH inserts an item and POP removes the top item

questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! PUSH ወደ stack ያስገባል፤ POP ከላይ ያለውን ያወጣል። አትቀያይር፤ እንደ ጫማ ግራና ቀኝ አይደሉም!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: PUSH inserts an item and POP removes the top item.

questions.question: If a stack is empty and TOP is initialized to −1, what is TOP after one item is pushed in the lecture's example?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! ባዶ ሲሆን TOP=−1፤ አንድ ንጥል ሲገባ TOP=0 ይሆናል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 0.

questions.question: How many bits are used for one byte?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 1 byte = 8 bits። ይህ የchapter መሠረታዊ መለኪያ ነው፤ እንደ ሻይ ስኳር አትርሳው!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 8.

questions.question: How many bytes are in one 16-bit word?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 16 bits = 2 bytes። ስለዚህ word ሁለት byte ይይዛል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 2.

questions.question: According to the slide, how is ASCII character '5' stored in one byte?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! በስላይዱ መሠረት ASCII '5' 7-bit 0110101 ነው፤ በbyte ውስጥ 00110101 ሆኖ ይቀመጣል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 00110101.

questions.question: The lecture's memory bytes decode to which string?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! በስላይዱ ምሳሌ በ01100 እስከ 01104 ያሉት ASCII bytes 'ASCII' ይሆናሉ።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: ASCII.

questions.question: In packed BCD, what does each 4-bit nibble represent?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! Packed BCD እያንዳንዱ 4-bit nibble አንድ decimal digit ይወክላል፤ አንድ byte ሁለት digits ይይዛል።
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: One decimal digit.

questions.question: How many instruction bytes can the 8088 prefetch queue hold, according to the lecture?
questions.explanation_am: ትክክል! 8088 4-byte prefetch queue አለው፤ 8086 ግን 6-byte ነው። ሁለቱን ቁጥር አትቀያይር!
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: 4.
